arabic text:
All my people I have left, from my city I have fled, tears
in my eyes hand on chest
Oh your place is sanctuary, In your land is sanctity,
heaven-on-earth I can perceive
For you the heavens do call, at your gate the angels crawl
english translation text:
I have left all my people and fled my
city, tears in my eyes and my hand upon my
chest. Your land is a sanctuary, and holiness lives
within it; I can perceive heaven upon earth. The heavens
call for you, and angels bow at your gate.

arabic text:
To the world my love is crazed, to my heart your name it
pains, oh Karbala your scent we crave
For you I would walk the lands, for your blessed golden
sands, oh the test of time you stand
How I have waited for this day, to walk upon this path
one day..
english translation text:
To the world my love appears like madness;
your name aches within my heart, and we
long for Karbala's fragrance. For you I would
cross every land, for your blessed golden sands that
have withstood the test of time. How long
I waited for this day—to walk upon this path.

arabic text:
Oh the passion I do show, In me love's seeds you have
sewn, Furat within me does flow
You're the moon within the night, you're the guiding ship
of light, for Islam you did fight
How in passion I'm enflamed, your land on my heart is
engrained..
english translation text:
The passion within me burns; you have sown
the seeds of love in my soul, and the
Euphrates flows within me. You are the moon
within the night, the guiding ship of light, and
you fought for Islam. My heart is aflame
with love, and your land is engraved upon it.

arabic text: How patient can one man be, Oh Abbas can't bear to see,\nthe Children weak & thirsty
english translation text: How much patience can one man possess? Abbas cannot bear to see\nthe children weak and thirsty.

arabic text: Alone he was outnumbered, He lays armless on your\nEarth, as it weeps for its self worth, How I wish to stand\nby you, flag bearer of the only truth
english translation text: Alone and outnumbered, he lies without arms upon your earth;\nthe land itself weeps over its helplessness. How I wish I had stood beside you,\nO standard-bearer of truth.

arabic text:
In your kingdom in your place, I search for the Blessed
face, that will save us all one day
One who will avenge Hussain! The radiant light he
retains! darkness to light he will change..
How we call for you Today, Return Mahdi we pray!
english translation text:
Within your kingdom and your land, I search
for the blessed face that will save us
all one day—the one who will avenge Hussain,
whose radiant light will turn darkness into light.
We call today: return, O Mahdi, we pray.

arabic text:
What can be said of that day, the final place he was slain,
by the ones who went astray
How upon you they did prey, hypocrisy they displayed,
by the ones who went astray
God's mercy from them be removed, blessings be upon
the truth
english translation text:
What can be said of that day,
and of the place where he was
finally slain by those who went astray?
They preyed upon him and exposed their
hypocrisy. May God's mercy be withheld from
them, and blessings remain upon the truth.

arabic text:
Your wounds I wish to attend, your broke heart I wish to
mend, your tents I wish to defend
Once more my pledge I renew, how I wish to be with you,
standing on the side of the truth
How upon you reigned the spears, yet you stood without a
fear…
english translation text:
I wish to tend your wounds, mend
your broken heart and defend your tents.
Once more I renew my pledge: how I
wish I had been with you, standing
upon the side of truth, while spears rained
upon you and you stood without fear.

arabic text:
Ali's eloquence now talks, zainul abideen he walks, lesson
of patience he taught
Beaten dragged shackled in chains, upon him his illness
pains, but his lords pleasure he gains
As he did the walk that time, we walk now to your blessed
shrine
english translation text:
Ali's eloquence now speaks as Zayn al-Abidin
walks, teaching the lesson of patience. Beaten,
dragged and shackled in chains, afflicted
by illness, yet attaining his Lord's pleasure.
As he walked that journey then,
we now walk towards your blessed shrine.
